description: Java class representing a report for a closed AMQP session, including references to a session object and a connection failure.

classes.name: SessionClosedStatusReport
classes.description: Encapsulates information about a closed AMQP session, including the session object and failure reason.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of SessionClosedStatusReport with specified failure and session.

methods.name: getFailure
methods.description: Returns the connection failure object associated with the session closure.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns the session object that was closed.
